DeterminationBasis: The existing T05 tests address evidence provenance, admissibility, changed evidence, authentication boundaries, missing evidence properties, package re-hashability, absence-of-evidence reasoning and stable evidence identity. None directly requires the evidence class itself to be explicitly represented when different epistemic classes could materially affect a determination. Explicit epistemic evidence-class representation therefore remains a distinct test obligation.

The existing T05 tests do not directly establish that an external evidence payload, or a verifiable content reference to that payload, is bound to an integrity identifier when payload integrity is claimed. Independent re-hashability tests reproducibility of a preserved package but does not by itself establish the required payload-or-reference-to-integrity binding. This remains a distinct test obligation.
